ayuda_texto: Open the JSON output of the admission preparation tool. Review the reasons and proposed actions. Supporting data and references are collapsed. You can download the original or close the file. The file stays in memory only: open it again after reloading. This review does not save data, issue a correction request or approve lists.
archivo_pista: Select the admission JSON output, not the tool input or the draft application. Maximum 4 MiB.
limite: Use synthetic data only. The file is not verified and does not constitute an admission decision.
vacio: Open a preparation tool file to review outstanding checks.
cargado: File opened. Review the reasons; all requirements remain pending.
descarga_lista: Download prepared with the original bytes. The file remains unverified and does not establish admission.
error_tamano: Cannot open the file: it is empty or exceeds 4 MiB. Select a smaller preparation tool output.
error_formato: Cannot open the file: it does not match the admission preparation tool output. Generate the output again and select it.
error_catalogo: The screen text could not be loaded. Reload the screen before opening a file.
universo_pendiente: Proposed list not checked against the exact selection rules. Requirements may be missing; compliance has not been assessed.
requisitos: Proposed requirements: reasons and next step
sin_requisitos: No proposed requirements. Define the list and check it against the exact selection rules before reviewing applications.
fecha_propuesta: Proposed assessment date: {fecha}. Pending a check against the selection rules.
soportes_limite: Data supplied by the synthetic package. Their status and validity do not resolve the requirement or change the Single Merit Register.
sin_soportes: No supporting data supplied for this requirement.
ver_detalle: View technical details and full content
referencias_limite: References are not queried. Matching versions and hashes in the file do not establish their source or correspondence.
solicitud_ref: Public identifier supplied by the local application
huella_solicitud: Hash of the original local application bytes

estados_soporte.acreditado: Verified according to the package · Not verified here
estados_soporte.rechazado: Rejected according to the package · Applicability pending

causas.fuentes_no_verificadas: Facts and sources still need to be queried through an authorised channel.
causas.texto_libre: The requirement is proposed as free text. An approved structured rule is needed to assess it.
causas.regla_ausente: No reference to an approved structured rule has been supplied.
causas.evaluador_pendiente: A rule is proposed, but its authorised evaluator is missing. The rule has not been applied.
causas.rechazo_aplicabilidad_pendiente: Supporting data are marked as rejected. Check whether that rejection affects the requirement in these selection rules.
causas.vigencia_aplicabilidad_pendiente: The stated validity of supporting data does not cover the proposed date. Check which milestone the selection rules require.
causas.dato_no_aportado: Expected facts or their definition are missing. Their absence does not constitute an exclusion.
causas.acreditacion_pendiente: Some supporting data are not marked as verified or state no supporting documents. Verification and applicability still need to be reviewed.

acciones.preparar_revision: Prepare to review the supporting data against the approved selection rules and assessment rule. The requirement awaits a competent decision.
acciones.preparar_aportacion: Identify the missing data or verification. Prepare the submission allowed by the selection rules; this is not yet a formal correction request.

pendientes.bases_universo: Check the proposed list against every requirement in the exact selection rules.
pendientes.correspondencia_solicitud: Check the correspondence between application, requirement, fact and version.
pendientes.lectura_autorizada: Query facts in Merit and Personnel using the appropriate permissions.
pendientes.identidad_registro_documentos: Complete identification, representation, submission, registration and document review through their relevant processes.
pendientes.subsanacion_bases: Define the correction process according to the selection rules, with an evidenced request and deadline.
pendientes.aprobacion_listas: Obtain the competent decision and its evidence before approving or publishing lists.
